title: R23 expansion rule amendment: grey-zone seed check
authorization: User 2026-10-26 「加进去吧」 after the main session proposed it (question 「这个大于等于3pp是不是有点太严格了」).

amends.note: PROTOCOL.json and FREEZE.json are left unchanged so the frozen run.py verify() keeps passing; this file is the registered addendum.

registered_before_any_dev.statement: Written before LOCK.json and before any DEV pilot evaluation; no DEV metric of any R23 run had been computed.

original_rule: P3 - P4 >= +3 pp strict on DEV deform with p95 not worse (p95_err(P3) - p95_err(P4) <= 0, as implemented in run.py analyze): expand (P3 and P4 only: 30000-step runs and seeds 1002/1003, separate package).

amended_rule.expand: Unchanged: delta = P3 - P4 strict success on DEV deform (pp, core macro, seed 1001) >= +3.0 and p95 not worse -> expand as in the original rule.
amended_rule.grey_zone: +1.5 <= delta < +3.0 and p95 not worse -> before any expansion, run P3 and P4 with their locked configs (LOCK.json) at seeds 1002 and 1003, 10000 steps, identical protocol (same deformation generator, conditions, domain, DEV evaluation); 4 new runs, ~2-3 GPUh, separate small package reusing run.py by import with only the seed changed.
amended_rule.grey_zone_decision: Expand only if the 3-seed mean P3 - P4 strict on DEV deform >= +3.0 pp AND >= 2 of 3 seeds positive AND the 3-seed mean p95 difference <= 0; otherwise report and stop this line.
amended_rule.stop: delta < +1.5 pp, or p95 worse -> report all pilots and stop this line (or an explicitly new design).
amended_rule.reporting: All 8 pilots and both references are reported in full regardless of the branch taken; the grey-zone seeds do not replace the seed-1001 pilot, they are reported alongside it.

rationale: Single-seed pilot: BF re-evaluation noise of one checkpoint is 0.6-2.2 pp strict, and past BF paired differences varied by several pp across seeds (e.g. dense N2048 exact-BCE +0.94/+7.19/-0.63). The +3 pp bar is kept for expansion; the grey zone guards against a false negative from one seed without lowering the bar. The formal application target stays >= +5 pp vs the strongest NCE.
not_changed: formal target (>= +5 pp vs strongest NCE)
_publication_note: Public excerpt: identity/hash/receipt/host fields and per-problem rows omitted, sample names pseudonymized, numbers unchanged.
